description: Source code for a Rust module implementing a ConfigSet for managing configuration files in a Git-related project, including methods for loading files, retrieving integer and string values, and managing memory.

classes.name: ConfigSet
classes.description: A struct representing an in-memory cache for Git configuration files, with methods for adding files and retrieving configuration values.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new ConfigSet instance by allocating resources.

methods.name: add_files
methods.description: Loads multiple configuration files into the ConfigSet, overriding conflicting directives.

methods.name: get_int
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value for a given key from the configuration.

methods.name: get_string
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a given key from the configuration.
